chunks: And by this chain, it was said: A matter was raised to Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him),

a man who squeezed the stomach of a man until he defecated in his clothes. So he (peace be upon him) judged upon him that he (also) be squeezed in the stomach until he defecates in his clothes, just as he had defecated, or he is fined one-third of the wergild.

key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: Blood money / Compensation for injury or death

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling for causing someone to defecate in their clothes according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam Ali (AS) illustrates the application of *qisas* (equivalent retribution) for indirect bodily harm, where the cause (squeezing) leads to a specific effect (defecation). It highlights the Shia jurisprudential nuance of offering the victim a choice between exact retribution or accepting one-third of the *diyah* (blood money), reflecting the flexibility in compensating for non-lethal but significant physical distress.
